title: 터진 노른자 재앙

cuts.scene: Kitchen. Wife stares at a broken egg yolk in a frying pan, looking exasperated. Her face is scrunched up.
Kitchen. Husband, leaning against the counter, sips coffee. He glances at the wife with a dry expression, slow to react.
Kitchen. Wife spots a small, clay toy product on the counter, next to the pan. She picks it up, looking puzzled.
Kitchen. Wife uses the clay toy product to separate the egg white from the yolk. Her eyes widen in surprise as it works.
Kitchen. Husband, still sipping coffee, gives a slight, knowing smirk. His tone is flat and teasing.
Guide character appears, holding up a product card for 'the clay toy product'. A '글쎄' (Hmm) stamp appears on the card. Guide looks directly at the camera, speaking clearly.
Kitchen. Wife, now holding the separated egg, looks speculatively towards a kitchen drawer, as if remembering something else she bought.
Kitchen. Husband is back to sipping coffee, looking at the wife with a resigned expression as she eyes the drawer. The scene is similar to Cut 1.

situation: 아침 계란 요리 중 노른자 터짐
